form.category: Supermarket grocery retail, weekly household shop

form.differentiator: Everyday low prices for the household shop, at 40 stores.

tier_0_default.why: Cheaper or no purchase at all.

tier_1_cheap_substitute.why: Lowest shelf price for the same basket.

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same product: a weekly grocery basket. 691 stores islandwide.

members: NTUC FairPrice - the national default, 125 stores
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: FairPrice owns 'default', Sheng Siong owns 'value+fresh', Cold Storage owns 'premium'.

tier_4_adjacent_crossover.why: Same need (feed the household) via a different channel.

tier_7_new_entrants.why: Derived from new openings and the DFI ownership change.

derived_competitive_set._derivation_method: Derived from the PRODUCT CATEGORY (Supermarket grocery retail, weekly household shop), not the owner's list. Price spread in this category: moderate (premium vs value shelf). Tiers follow the eight-tier frame: default/no-purchase, cheap substitute, direct set, category incumbent (the rungs of the customer's mental ladder), adjacent crossover, indirect, and new entrants derived from public opening records.
